Definition: probably from G2031; properly, affable, i.e. mild or kind:--gentle.
BiblicalUsage: Epios means gentle, mild, kind — affable. Paul says, we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children; and the servant of the Lord must not strive, but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient.
TheologicalSignificance: A nurse's care and a teacher's patience — gentleness is strength under control, and the Lord's servant cannot afford to lose it.
